reviews.title: Customization + Purpose = win
reviews.text: I appreciate being able to write in my reasons to stay off the phone, and having those reasons pop up as reminders of what I could be doing with my time instead. While I did shift to my laptop a bit more, Roots had me genuinely wanting to use my phone less by the end of my first week.  The dopamine hits and tree visualization are nice stats to have, and the mindful breathing is a nice physiological reset even if I do unlock after. Worth the premium for me!

reviews.title: Curbed my doom scrolling, and great developer support
reviews.text:
I purchased a subscription to help me cut down on my doom scrolling, and it’s done the job admirably. I love customization options and the way the app can introduce friction when you choose to break your own rules and override the limits.

But even more impressive, when I had a question for a setting I couldn’t work out, and couldn’t find the answer to, I was able to message the co-founder via the support site and got a detailed reply that solved my issue in a couple of hours.

I wholeheartedly recommend this app for helping you cut down on doomscrolling. It’s superb.

reviews.title: Great tool for phone addiction
reviews.text:
I recently started graduate school after a long period of a work sabbatical & in that time a lot of bad habits around my phone usage got their hooks in me. Because I wasn’t working, I emailed the developers to see if I could use the Pro version for free and they got back to me right away and granted that to me. It was very nice! :) 

This app has been extremely helpful for understanding just how much time I spend on my phone scrolling social media, and being able to create better habits from that info. Thanks to the app, I was able to start locking myself out of all social apps until the early afternoon, then changed it to 5 pm, and now have taken them off my phone entirely while still locking myself out of the web versions….all within six months of having this tool. That wouldn’t have been possible without this app. It’s been very helpful for keeping me on track with school. 

The functionality of it is great, it’s easy to navigate, & given me a clear picture of what’s needed to change. I appreciate that you can easily choose which apps to include or take off of your usage report, as I don’t really need to know how much time I spend on search engines or maps since those are tools and not distractions for me. 

Overall, this app is a great tool for anyone wanting to make positive changes around their phone usage so they can start living life!

I have a 340 day streak and haven’t felt the need to break it as if I need to adjust my screen time limits I can after a 12 hour cooldown. As a student, this is a great way to actually brick your phone for studying—would totally recommend to all students out there that need help disconnecting from their phone.

reviews.title: Changed my Life
reviews.text: I’ve never written a review for an app before - but this app warrants all the five stars I can give. I downloaded the app around a year and a half ago, and it has completely changed the way I interact with my phone and social media. Before Roots, I had a very difficult time resisting the addictive effect of scrolling through endless reels and posts. Especially as a student, I wanted to curb my social media use to invest more time in my studies. By setting three five minute limits for social media, I am still able to interact and respond to friends’ posts and engage in content I find interesting without falling down the rabbit hole of endless scrolling. I also find the ability to build a “streak” to gain “pauses” aka individual days without limits very encouraging and effective. In my experience, it is worth every penny.

reviews.title: It just works
reviews.text:
For the longest time, I thought restricting screen time was simply a matter of self discipline, but these platforms are specifically designed to trap your mind and waste away your life. If you’re constantly dealing with software engineered for you to lose, why not try something designed for you to win?

Of all the screen time apps I’ve tried, Roots is significantly the most effective and unpretentious at doing just that. For one, it doesn’t use flashy colors, animations, or haptics drawing attention to itself, which makes sense as that is exactly what an app like this should be reducing. It’s a simple interface yet extremely customizable in terms of blocking yet very uncomplicated to configure. 

My favorite part is that it reminds me that I’m looking out for myself; gently yet firmly guiding me away from time drains. I have it set to block certain apps and websites in the morning and at night because the compulsion to scroll was ruining my sleep. I also like that I can select which apps don’t count towards screen time eg. maps when driving so I can actually see how much I’m diverting my life awareness into the screen. It gives you a score for each day and you can go back and see your progress. 

There’s more that I love about this app but just download it and see for yourself. Thank you.

reviews.title: Completely changed how I use my phone
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for a few years, and it’s completely changed how I use my phone. What brought me to Roots is how simple it is, no annoying bloat that a lot of blocking apps have. It has a bunch of really great features, but the one that keeps me subscribing is how it handles scheduled blocking. For distracting apps like instagram, I have it set to allow me 10-minute unblocks 3 times a day whenever I choose. Because I have it sent to “monk mode” difficulty, there’s no easy way to ignore it. Before I downloaded this app, I’d sometimes loose hours of my life scrolling. Now, there are days where I don’t open the apps at alll. It’s been wild to see how addicted to socials I was and incredibly satisfying to feel that ache completely disappear. Very grateful to the Roots team for this tool, highly highly recommend
